Hello Safety Team,


I am a treating physician at Fictional General Hospital (demo) (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 39-year-old male patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their second dose of DemoGluca (dose: 25mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-04-17.
Approximately 4 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed mild fatigue.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
A. Duval (fictional reporter)
Fictional General Hospital (demo)
